macros.name: btPrintAll
macros.doc: The union of \btPrintCited and \btPrintNotCited: prints all references from ⟨bib-files⟩, no matter if they have been cited or not.

macros.name: btPrintCited
macros.doc: Prints all references from ⟨bib-files⟩ that have been cited within the scope of the current btUnit environment (or in the entire document, if there is no btUnit environment – see the description of the btUnit environment below).

macros.name: btPrintNotCited
macros.doc: Prints all references from ⟨bib-files⟩ for the citations occurring in ⟨bib-files⟩ that have not been cited in the current scope.

envs.name: btSect
envs.doc: This is the main environment of bibtopic.sty. It serves as a ‘container’ for the commands \btPrintCited, \btPrintNotCited and \btPrintAll that actually print the bibliographies.

envs.name: btUnit
envs.doc: Normally, when you invoke one of the \btPrint{Cited|NotCited} commands, ‘cited’ means: A reference that has been cited somewhere in the entire document. However, if you enclose a part of your document into the btUnit environment, the scope of the citations is narrowed to this environment.
